title: TCPCL: Add preference to allow missing Contact Header
description:
This also adds heuristic dissector to detect start-of-connection.

Closes #18176

notes.body: I received some feedback to allow a preference for checking v3 or v4 messages first, as some have identical sizes and are indistinguishable.
The last changes include a multi choice protocol parameter to disable message heuristics or choose a priority of protocol versions.
